behaviorChanges: installed-package (pip/pipx) runtimes now probe PyPI (https://pypi.org/pypi/tautline/json) for the available release and print a `framework_update_offer:` line with the pipx/pip update command when a newer version exists, completing roadmap #15 for the package runtime (PR 1 covered git checkouts). Read-only, fail-open, 24h cache, 3s timeout; opt out with `TAUTLINE_METHODOLOGY_UPDATE_PROBE=off`. Display-only: no policy, trust, or exit-code change, and the package-mode remote-status line is byte-identical to before.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below 0.14.5 removes the PyPI availability/offer for installed-package runtimes; the probe cache is inert and can be deleted. No state migration.
grant-gh-project-scopes is carried forward from 0.10.3 (see requiredMigrations); a lane already on 0.10.3+ needs no action.
NOT WIP-safe only for the engine-gap carry-forward; the release's own change is display-only and safe for lanes in progress.
